[![支持NeoForge](https://vinnystalck.gitlab.io/minecraft-badges/badges/neoforge/compact-supports.svg)](https://modrinth.com/mod/exposure-knowlogy/versions?l=neoforge)

[![Modrinth下载量](https://img.shields.io/modrinth/dt/onbX6Nsj?style=flat&logo=modrinth&label=Downloads&labelColor=03190a&color=1e1e1e)](https://modrinth.com/mod/exposure-knowlogy)
[![CurseForge下载量](https://img.shields.io/curseforge/dt/1230608?style=flat&logo=curseforge&label=Downloads&labelColor=241009&color=1e1e1e)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/exposure-knowlogy)

这是为[Knowlogy](https://modrinth.com/mod/knowlogy)开发的扩展模组，它将[Exposure](https://modrinth.com/mod/exposure)模组的相关说明添加到**知识之书**中，展示来自[Exposure官方Wiki](https://moddedmc.wiki/en/project/exposure/docs)的信息。

## 依赖项

[![知识之书](https://vinnystalck.gitlab.io/minecraft-badges/badges/knowlogy/compact-requires.svg)](https://modrinth.com/mod/knowlogy)
[![曝光](https://vinnystalck.gitlab.io/minecraft-badges/badges/exposure/compact-requires.svg)](https://modrinth.com/mod/exposure)
[![曝光：拍立得](https://vinnystalck.gitlab.io/minecraft-badges/badges/exposure-polaroid/compact-recommends.svg)](https://modrinth.com/mod/exposure-polaroid)

## 功能特性

### 合成配方

![胶片条目](https://gitlab.com/VinnyStalck/knowlogy/-/raw/exposure/main/assets/images/film-entry.png)

展示每个物品和方块的合成配方，并关联相关条目。

### 使用指南

![相机控制页面](https://gitlab.com/VinnyStalck/knowlogy/-/raw/exposure/main/assets/images/camera-controls-page.png)

配有图片和动态键位说明，帮助更好理解操作方式。

### 深度解析

![彩色冲印流程](https://gitlab.com/VinnyStalck/knowlogy/-/raw/exposure/main/assets/images/chromatic-process-page.png)

详细讲解游戏机制原理。

### 扩展支持

![即时相机条目](https://gitlab.com/VinnyStalck/knowlogy/-/raw/exposure/main/assets/images/instant-camera-entry.png)

包含对[曝光：拍立得](https://modrinth.com/mod/exposure-polaroid)模组的支持条目。
